header.title: Connect an agent
header.subtitle: Give a coding agent on your machine access to this proxy-monster instance over MCP. It signs in as you through OAuth and gets exactly your access.

agent.title: Paste this to your agent
agent.body: Works in Claude Code and Codex CLI. The agent installs the server; you approve the sign-in in your browser. Pasting it again replaces an earlier install of this instance.
agent.step1: Add an HTTP (streamable HTTP) MCP server named {installName} with the URL {mcpUrl}, in user scope so it is available in every project. If a server named {installName} already exists, replace it.
agent.step2: Start its OAuth login in my browser. In Claude Code, tell me to run /mcp, pick {installName}, and choose Authenticate. No token or password is needed.
agent.after: Once connected, the server describes itself and the datasources I can use.

unsupported.title: Not supported
unsupported.body: claude.ai, Claude Desktop, and ChatGPT connect to remote MCP servers from the vendor's cloud, not from your machine. proxy-monster servers are private and accept direct connections from agents on your machine only.
